subject: FastCart pricing: window-size & token mix recap
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@fastcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:04:00-05:00
Subject: Post-call recap — window-size, token mix, next steps

Elena / FastCart team,

Thanks for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap from our discovery and the facts we need to confirm before I put together a proposal: 

Key usage signals you shared (verbal):
- Primary product: checkout assistant + personalized offers served at checkout.
- Live sessions: ~30k sessions/day peak; expected steady-state 18–22k/day after Q1 rollout.
- Expected monthly token volume (estimate range): 10M — 15M prompt tokens, 12M — 18M completion tokens (aggregate).

Context / window needs (rough):
- 70% of requests fit comfortably within an 8k window (multi-turn summary + cart state).
- ~25% need 32k when including full product catalog snippet + session history.
- ~5% flagged as long-tail (128k) for advanced debug/analytics or full-order history retrieval.

Per-request typical sizes (examples you gave):
- Avg prompt tokens: 320—420 (most around 350).
- Avg completion tokens: 380—520 (median ~420).
- Example: add-to-cart recommendation prompt ~360 tokens, completion ~420 tokens.

Budget / target unit-econ you mentioned in call:
- Finance is looking for target pricing in the neighborhood of $700—$900 per 1M tokens for predictable monthly spend (this is a blended target across prompt+completion).

What I need to finalize a tailored quote and a recommended deployment plan:
1) Confirm an expected monthly committed tokens range (low/mid/high) — useful for a reserved capacity plan.
2) Share any requirements for data residency/audit that would affect private deployment.
3) If procurement has lead times or PO constraints, share those so we can sync contract timeline.

Next steps I propose:
- I will draft a 2-tier pricing scenario (hosted optimized + dedicated reserved) with explicit $/1M token numbers and model variants for 8k/32k/128k runs.
- Attachments: please find sample prompt extract and product-flow map I pulled from the call notes.
- Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the pricing scenarios with your finance + procurement?

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment stubs:
- fastcart_sample_prompts.csv (CSV of 25 representative prompt/completion pairs)
- fastcart_MVP_map.pdf (flow diagram)
From: Elena Park <elena@fastcart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastcart.com
Date: 2026-11-08T10:17:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — window-size, token mix, next steps

Thanks Jonas — this looks right, quick clarifications from our side: 

Confirmed volumes (internal estimate):
- Monthly baseline: ~18M prompt tokens, ~21M completion tokens (we are comfortable +/- 20% for Q1).
- Peak single-day sessions: ~32k (we expect spikes Black Friday style).

Window breakdown (we ran a quick sample):
- ~68% 8k windows (short session state + product context).
- ~27% 32k windows (cart + product catalog slice).
- ~5% 128k windows (rare exports, full order history).

Token size distribution (sample):
- Median prompt: 355 tokens; 75th percentile 480.
- Median completion: 410 tokens; 75th percentile 640.

Budget guidance: finance would prefer an initial blended target of $750 / 1M tokens (blended across prompts+completions), but we are open to seeing a tiered proposal where 128k usage is priced higher or falls under a dedicated/reserved SKU.

Procurement note: standard PO + 45-day net is typical; if you need faster cycle we can expedite but would need a SOW + invoice cadence spelled out.

Would appreciate:
- A worked example showing cost at 3 commitment levels (12M, 25M, 40M total tokens) and how the mix (8k/32k/128k) changes blended $/1M.
- Any guidance on optimizations (prefix caching, batching) we should consider to hit the $750 target.

Happy to take the follow-up next Wed (Nov 10) after finance reviews the sample prompts you attached.

—Elena
Elena Park | Head of Product, FastCart
elena@fastcart.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@fastcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@fastcart.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — window-size, token mix, next steps

Elena — thanks for the fast clarifications. Below is a concise worked example and next steps. I kept it deliberately conservative on completion sizes so you can see downside protection.

Worked examples (blended costs assume standard hosted API pricing tiers; I will follow up with Dedicated reserved quotes if you prefer commitment discounts):

Assumptions we used:
- Model baseline: medium-latency variant optimized for batching.
- Prompt tokens billed + completion tokens billed (blended).
- Percent of total requests by window: 8k=68%, 32k=27%, 128k=5%.
- Avg token sizes: prompt=355, completion=410 (use your medians).

Scenario A — 12M total tokens/month (entry commit):
- Cost sensitivity: no reserved discount.
- Blended price needed to meet finance target: ~$900 / 1M tokens => monthly cost ~ $10.8k (this is above target).

Scenario B — 25M total tokens/month (recommended MVP commit):
- With modest reserved pricing + batching optimization (20% effective token saving on completions): blended target reachable at ~$760 / 1M tokens => monthly cost ~ $19k.

Scenario C — 40M total tokens/month (growth commit):
- Larger reserved capacity + additional caching for catalog slices (additional 10% saving): blended $/1M can approach ~$650 / 1M => monthly cost ~ $26k.

Notes by window:
- 8k runs: highest opportunity for batching; effective per-million cost materially lower when batched in pools.
- 32k runs: higher per-call compute; recommend a slightly cheaper model variant for cases where hallucination risk is low.
- 128k runs: treat as dedicated job / fallthrough; price these as a separate SKU or route to Dedicated to avoid bloating hosted costs.

Optimization levers to hit $750 target:
- Prefix caching for repetitive catalog slices (~10–15% token saving for 32k mix).
- Aggressive batching for 8k flows in periods of throughput tolerances (~15–25% token saving).
- Model variant selection: mixed fleet approach (high-eff for 8k; high-context ops for 32k/128k).

Attachments: I re-attached the sample prompts and added a cost model sheet (fastcart_sample_prompts.csv, fastcart_MVP_map.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) I will produce a short spreadsheet with the three scenarios above broken down into prompt vs completion token spend and show the blended $/1M.
2) Schedule 30-min review Wed Nov 10 at 2pm ET to walk finance + procurement.
3) If you want us to price Dedicated reserved options, we can provide a draft term sheet and a 60/30/10 commitment tier by EOW.

If that works, I will send the spreadsheet + calendar invite.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
